scope: experimental safety and comparison protocol, not product qualification

series.randomization_seed_rule: generate one 256-bit seed before the series, record it with the ordered case list, and reuse it only for an exact replay
series.series_identity_rule: bind the seed, ordered cases, artifact digests, browser identity, environment fields, and all contract revisions before the first attempt

settling.sample_rule: retain every raw sample, its monotonic timestamp, source, unit, and declared measurement resolution
settling.quiescence_rule: all discrete generation-owned counters reach zero and the final three memory samples show no positive slope greater than the recorded measurement resolution

noise.rerun_trigger: for a strictly positive median, median-absolute-deviation exceeds 20 percent of the median; for a zero median, any nonzero deviation triggers; visibility or power state change always triggers
noise.rerun_disposition: retain noisy run, classify inconclusive, then run a newly identified series

safety_ceilings.enforcement_point: series supervisor before each case and on its monotonic deadline
safety_ceilings.breach_action: abort series and preserve partial evidence

safety_ceilings.enforcement_point: manifest validation and bounded fetch accounting
safety_ceilings.mechanism: overflow-checked declared sum plus observed byte counters
safety_ceilings.breach_action: reject before allocation or cancel the active fetch

safety_ceilings.mechanism: harness polling at each declared sample point
safety_ceilings.breach_action: terminate browser fixture and preserve partial evidence

semantic_comparison.oracle: same OTP source, same BEAM digests, native bootstrap versus browser Wasm
normalization_allowlist: scheduler interleaving explicitly declared by case
semantic_comparison.mismatch_disposition: fail the case; do not widen normalization after observing the mismatch without a reviewed contract revision

change_control: a change creates a new contract revision, records its rationale before another run, and never rewrites the contract attached to retained evidence
